title: You can find a better plate rack for about the same dough
text: You can find a better plate rack for about the same dough. Didn't come with wall hangers and the construction was cheap, cheap.  It only holds small plates.  Will make use of it, but not happy.

product_metadata.title: Tripar 3 Tier Vertical Black Plate Rack for Collectible Plates, Plaques, Dishes, & China
features: PREMIUM QUALITY MATERIAL: This vertical plate organizer is made from superior quality, extra resistant material, wall plate stands are made to withstand the test of time. The vintage look will preserve intact over the years, without rusting or fading its color.
STURDY METAL CONSTRUCTION - Beautifully crafted dish rack display stand from iron materials, this plate rack stand ensures long lasting quality and beauty.
MULTIPLE USES - Kitchen rack plate stand is the perfect plate hangers for the wall and can be used as plate stands for display rack for artwork, platters, trays, books and much more.

INDUSTRIAL STRENGTH AND DURABILITY: This plate holder display stand is easy to hang on walls, lightweight and durable. Wall hangers make a great kitchen stand but can also be hung in bedrooms, dining room, hallways and any other room.
PERFECTLY SIZED: Ideal size plate holders for wall to display your favorite plates, platters and more. The Vertical Wall Rack measures 7.25"W 1.8"D 27"H.
